purpose: Route each leg of a multi-currency Arc corridor to its per-currency home regime (EURC→MiCA EMT, JPYC→JP FSA, BRLA→Brazil CMN/BCB, MXNB→MX CNBV, etc.), flag missing per-regime disclosures, and emit PvP handoff (511) + Travel-Rule batch handoff (art-104). Compliance/settlement routing only; FX economics handled separately by the Arc StableFX chain.
